role: Declares nbtw, the one writer the entity NBT writers (living.c, entity_nbt.c, fallhang.c, endfight.c, the kinds', leash.c, trades.c, itemtag.c) write through, with two outputs implemented in nbtbin.c: the nbt tree (nbtw_tree) and the binary NBT the entity digest hashes (nbtw_bin_begin, nbtw_bin_end, nbtw_bin_order, nbtw_bin_long_memo), which puts each compound's fields into the JDK 8 HashMap order only when its bytes differ from the entity's last. The scalar writes are inline (nbtw_fast).

structs.name: nbtw
structs.java: an NBTTagCompound being filled by writeToNBT, as a tree or as the bytes its write gives

gpu: struct nbtw: a writer on the caller's stack pointing at heap-grown buffers (nbtbin, nw_env->nbtbin.wf)
